report.description:
Local mock report. The examination is presented in standard views. This demonstration text lets you review report layout, copying, saving and delivery without calling a neural model.

The uploaded images and examination notes are not analyzed in this mode.
report.conclusion: Demonstration conclusion for a local test examination.
report.recommendations: Demonstration recommendation: review the examination notes and recorded measurements before completing the report.
report.descriptionRemarks: Demonstration remark: specify the examination conditions and units of measurement. This text lets you check the description remarks section.

photoRemarkPoints.title: Check the measurement
photoRemarkPoints.description: Demonstration image remark: check the position of the measurement calipers and confirm the units. The point is fixed for UI testing and does not represent image analysis.

photoRemarkPoints.title: Clarify the region boundaries
photoRemarkPoints.description: Demonstration image remark: check that the region of interest is fully visible. This second point lets you test selecting different remarks on the same image.
